title: Open Knowledge Format standards register
purpose: Central reference for OKF core specifications, separately versioned local profiles and public bundle discovery. This register does not itself assert conformance or adoption.

historical_core.provenance_note: Immutable revision already used by this repository's conformance and authoring references. No separate release date is asserted here.

verification.method: GitHub path history and immutable raw content

historical_core.provenance_note: The pinned document identifies itself as OKF version 0.1. The revision date is the Git commit date; no separate release announcement date is asserted.

profiles.note: This local semantic profile has its own version and lifecycle. Its presence does not change the core version declared by any bundle or constitute OKF 0.3 adoption.
Versioned implementation profile retaining frozen v1 structural dependencies; each producer requires separate acceptance.
New domain handoffs target core0.3; historical v1/core0.2 handoffs remain available.

public_bundle_access.title: Curated public bundle access directory
public_bundle_access.scope: Thirteen reviewed public owner-authored bundle entries at the directory's observation date; this is a discovery catalogue, not a complete owner inventory or conformance decision.

public_owner_candidates.title: Public owner repository candidate scan
public_owner_candidates.scope: Public default-branch discovery covering declared indexes and runtime markers. Captures and diagnostic projections are labelled separately. Review each candidate before asserting bundle or release acceptance.

prior_public_owner_candidates.title: Public owner repository candidate scan
prior_public_owner_candidates.scope: Public default-branch discovery covering declared indexes and runtime markers. Captures and diagnostic projections are labelled separately. Review each candidate before asserting bundle or release acceptance.

limitations: The owner catalogue covers public repositories only. Private repositories are deliberately excluded.
Repository declarations and candidate evidence do not prove current publication, core conformance, semantic-profile adoption or release approval.
Keep historical bundle versions and frozen evidence pinned to their original source revision.

reviewed_public_producer_sources.discovery_basis: Reviewed source repository; generated release artefacts are stored outside Git.
